confirm.title: Reauthenticate Thermacell LIV
confirm.description:
Authentication with Thermacell has failed for **{entry_title}**.

To fix this issue:
1. Go to **Settings** → **Devices & Services**
2. Find the **Thermacell LIV** integration
3. Click the three dots menu and select **Reauthenticate**
4. Enter your updated credentials

After reauthenticating successfully, this issue will be automatically resolved.

device_offline.title: Device Offline
device_offline.description: Your Thermacell device **{device_name}** is currently offline or unreachable.

confirm.title: Device Offline: {device_name}
confirm.description:
The device **{device_name}** is currently offline or unreachable.

**Troubleshooting steps:**
1. Check that the device has power
2. Verify your home network connectivity
3. Check if the Thermacell cloud service is operational
4. Try power cycling the device
5. Check if the device is still registered in your Thermacell account

If the device comes back online, this issue will be automatically resolved.
